sections.title: Foreign buyers and Bulgarian land ownership
facts: Non-EU buyers cannot own Bulgarian land directly in their own name.
For land ownership, a Non-EU buyer normally needs a Bulgarian company structure such as an OOD.
EU and EEA buyers are handled differently and should confirm the current purchase structure with a lawyer before signing.

sections.title: Foreign-buyer financing checks
facts: Foreign-national mortgage availability can be limited in Bulgaria.
MS Realty treats financing as an early qualification item, not a late-stage surprise.
